provenance_definitions.fact: directly inspected PPTX structure, text formatting, embedded image or source hash
provenance_definitions.default: reusable design recommendation, not an exact value on every source slide

product-story.structure: thin top rule, part label, claim title, supporting lead, one main evidence visual

dark-opening.surface: navy with white text or split navy/white contents
dark-opening.structure: large type, blue accent, generous negative space

service-evidence.structure: denser source-backed service diagrams, tables and references

closing.structure: oversized closing statement and current contact only

typography.missing_font_action: record installed fallback and recheck text fit

layout_system.coordinate_system: fractions of canvas unless explicitly px
layout_system.part_label_to_title: one compact step; keep title aligned to left margin
layout_system.content_pattern: one claim and one primary visual/evidence relation per page

archetypes.structure: dark field, small brand label, oversized claim, single blue emphasis
navy left panel, numbered sections on white, active pale-blue band
milestone line above concise risk categories
aligned columns with common comparison criteria
current app or web screenshots, user role and concrete benefit
large verified metrics and supporting evidence/units
numbered stages with input, action and output
large close, white space, current contact footer

assets.cover_label: editable INNerCarry text plus blue rounded-square accent, not an official standalone logo file
assets.product_screenshots: replace with current verified project assets

visual_style_behavior: Use the INNerCarry product-story system: a white 4:3 canvas with a thin navy-to-blue top rule, shared left alignment, a small PART label, a large navy claim title, selective electric-blue emphasis, and one clear evidence diagram, comparison, process, metric, or current product screen per slide. Use IBM Plex Sans KR when installed, restrained pale-blue or light-gray surfaces, and dark-navy opening or closing pages only for section roles. Preserve current user facts, units, branding rights, and confirmed project values; do not reuse historical claims, customer logos, product screenshots, or contact details from the reference deck.
